note: The narration, one entry per line: t = film time (s) it starts, text = the subtitle, say = what the voice is given (numbers spelled for speech). Source of truth for the voice takes, the burned-in subtitles, captions.vtt and the music ducking. Lines and sources: video/SCRIPT.md.

lines.text: You frame the shot. I'll handle the exposure.
lines.say: You frame the shot. [short pause] I'll handle the exposure.

lines.text: Twenty-four times a second, I read the picture. In stops. Like a DP.
lines.say: Twenty-four times a second, I read the picture. In stops. Like a DP.

lines.text: Only inside the ranges you approve.
lines.say: Only inside the ranges you approve.
October nineteenth. A real F X 2.

lines.text: Two and a half stops hot. Coming down a third.
lines.say: Two and a half stops hot. Coming down a third.

lines.text: Interview look. Shutter, 1/48. Iris, f/4. White balance, 2800.
lines.say: Interview look. Shutter, one forty-eighth. Iris, f four. White balance, twenty-eight hundred.

lines.text: Every change is logged. Old value, new value, and why.
lines.say: Every change is logged. Old value, new value, and why.

lines.text: Next: a blind test. Me, the camera's own auto, and a human.
